summary: Iter29 validated the Pendaftaran registration-period gate for both backend and frontend. Backend pytest 8/8 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_registration_gate.py): initial site content settings.registration_open=false is asserted; POST /api/registration by mahasiswa demo while closed returns 403 with exact detail 'Masa pendaftaran belum dibuka. Silakan pantau pengumuman MDJ Scholarship secara berkala.'; GET /api/registration remains 200 while closed; PUT /api/site/content is blocked (403) for admin & student roles and allowed only for super_admin; temporary student (registered via /api/auth/register, later cleaned from Mongo) can POST draft when super_admin flips registration_open=true; after super_admin flips back to false the draft persists via GET but new POST returns 403 with the same message. Fixture teardown restores full snapshot with registration_open=false; final API check confirms state = false. Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844, closed period) verified: sidebar-toggle -> mobile-menu-daftar visible; clicking triggers registration-closed-dialog with the exact Indonesian message via registration-closed-dialog-message; registration-sections NOT rendered; close-registration-closed-dialog dismisses the modal; menu-daftar still visible after close; no horizontal overflow (documentElement scrollWidth 390 == clientWidth 390, body scrollWidth 390); dialog bbox {x:0,w:390} fits viewport. Desktop 1920 also verified: menu-daftar visible, dialog opens on click, no overflow. No test data left behind (temp users purged, registration_open restored to false).
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend testids from the review request (registration-submenu-formulir/pendidikan/dokumen) do NOT exist in code; RegistrationSections.jsx uses registration-tab-{formulir|pendidikan|dokumen}. Not a bug (tabs still fully accessible and only visible when period is open), but the E1 handoff note is inaccurate.

StudentDashboard.selectDashboardMenu falls back to opening the closed dialog when GET /api/site/content fails; this is fail-closed on the UI side, but if the network is flaky a legitimately-open period could temporarily render the dialog. Consider a lighter treatment (e.g., allow soft retry) or at least log the error to console. Not blocking.

is_registration_period_open() defaults to closed when site_content doc is missing or lacks the settings field (settings.get('registration_open') is True). Backend is correctly fail-closed on POST /api/registration. Good.
